title: Keeping Jerk in Check: Jointly Trained Perception-Gated Experts for Smooth Terrain Transitions
abstract: arXiv:2606.19633v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Perceptive legged locomotion across discontinuous terrain requires shared locomotion knowledge, task-specific maneuvers, and smooth transitions between them. Existing approaches train specialized policies independently and either switch among them with a hierarchical selector or distill them into a monolithic policy. Both fix the constituent behaviors before they are composed, and both are assessed through aggregate course outcomes that leave behavior at terrain boundaries uncharacterized. We instead propose CTS-MoE, which formulates multi-terrain locomotion as multi-task reinforcement learning and jointly trains a perception-gated dense mixture-of-experts actor with task-specific critics: soft routing composes expert knowledge into continuously varying behavior, while separated critics isolate heterogeneous objectives so that specialization survives joint optimization. translated_title: 控制抖动：联合训练的感知门控专家实现平滑地形过渡
translated_abstract: 在不连续地形上进行感知式腿式运动需要共享的运动知识、任务特定的机动动作，以及二者之间的平滑过渡。现有方法独立训练专用策略，然后要么通过分层选择器在它们之间切换，要么将它们蒸馏为单一的整体策略。这两种方法都在行为组合之前就固定了各个组成行为，并且都通过整体赛道结果进行评估，导致地形边界处的行为特征未被表征。我们转而提出CTS-MoE，将多地形运动表述为多任务强化学习，并联合训练一个感知门控的稠密专家混合执行器（actor）与任务特定的评论家（critics）：软路由将专家知识组合成连续变化的行为，而分离的评论家隔离了异构的目标，使策略专业化在联合优化中得以保留。并行的师生框架将该协……
tldr: 该论文提出CTS-MoE，将多地形腿式运动表述为多任务强化学习，通过联合训练感知门控的稠密专家混合actor与任务特定的critics，利用软路由组合专家知识，实现跨越不连续地形时连续平滑且保留专业化的运动行为。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CTS-MoE, which formulates multi-terrain legged locomotion as multi-task RL and jointly trains a perception-gated mixture-of-experts actor with task-specific critics, using soft routing to compose expert knowledge into smooth, continuously varying behaviors across discontinuous terrain.
